A script could join fifty times, so admission now dials a line. At join the applicant declares a landline at a street address; the node calls it, speaks a five digit code, and expects it repeated back in ninety seconds. Carrier record and copper pair are hashed with the key, so one line holds one seat and a rented VoIP number fails the check.

Install runs 50 dollars and 25 monthly, ten business days to wake, so fifty seats cost 1,250 upfront and 1,250 monthly before any credit.

An anchor holds because raising it costs more than the boat, and a cedar counts its rings one year at a time.
